name: MSM
headline: MSM
description: Bioavailable organic sulphur with biotin and vitamin C, to help strengthen cartilage and joints and improve the condition of skin, hair and nails. It also helps nourish and recover muscles after exercise.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule a day with food. Course: 1 month, repeated if needed.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
